svg.font-family: Helvetica, Arial, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
svg.title: How the earlier folders and the domains of thought meet the live account
svg.desc: 1,183 claims from 16 earlier folders and 12 domains of thought, each read against the live account. It states 491 in whole or in part and takes up 189 to say otherwise. 376 it does not state: a reader proposes the connection here. 105 it does not take up, and 22 stand only in its history. Every thread is an AI reading, and no person’s. Of 337 agreements, 130 are with a checked law, 67 with a thesis or method, and 140 rest on a reader’s join. A thread is not proof, a shared word is not a correspondence, and agreement is drawn no more prominently than divergence. 328 entries rest on the AI’s knowledge of a text not stored here, unchecked against that text. A random check of 100 entries estimates that about 14.2% of all carry a wrong label or target role and 3.2% a wrong reading.
svg.text: How the earlier folders and the domains of thought meet the live account
Drawn by connection_map.py from the crosswalk’s 1,183 claims, each read against the live account. A thread
joins an earlier folder or a domain of thought to the part of the account its claims are read against.
Every thread is an AI reading, no person’s. A thread is not proof, and agreement is drawn
A random check of 100 entries estimates about 14.2% of all with a wrong label or target role and 3.2% with a wrong reading.
3 carried · 488 in part · 189 changed · 376 proposed here · 22 only in history · 105 not carried
The parts of the account they are read against
間 and 文言 as formal language
The relational self and 大同
The selfishness spiral and narrative-value frames
Spirit, Token, Space and the Yi substrate
智善: intelligence must be good
Chinese classical, beyond the existing maps
Buddhist thought, as far as the account reaches
The counts are drawn claims, by relation; dashes only tell relations apart. A thread’s width grows with its claims;
a lighter thread is a connection the account does not state, proposed here.
The 127 claims only in history or not carried draw no thread (3 of them carry a relation, which the crosswalk’s table counts).
Beside a folder or domain the number counts all its claims; beside a part of the account, the drawn claims read against it,
a claim read against several parts counting at each.
Every claim with its targets and their standings: the crosswalk (CROSSWALK.md, in the same folder). The same data to explore:
map.html in that folder, which GitHub shows only as source.
